scope: What a single accuracy percentage for the 104 H01 cells would have to be a product of. No H01 cell has electrophysiology, so every term is a transfer claim and none of them is a measurement of an H01 cell.

terms.statement: B3 scores 71.8 percent on 10 elements against Allen 541563728's own recording at 310 pA. That donor is the type match for 28 of 104 cells.
terms.cause: The other three donors (Allen L4 527952884, HL5MN1, HL5BN1) had their published fits reproduced and rejected against their own recordings; no ten-element score exists for them, so this term is measured for 28 cells only and assumed for the rest.

terms.statement: 55 of 104 cells have a donor matched in both layer and class (52.9 percent).
terms.cause: The remaining 49 are matched on polarity or on part of the label only; they would inherit a model fitted to a different cell class.

terms.statement: All 104 of 104 largest soma-bearing components import with zero missing segments; construction passes with 808,495 compartments and no failures; initialisation passes; a forward pass completes all six phases at dt 0.005 ms, peak RSS 14.0 GiB.
terms.cause: This supersedes the earlier 12-of-104 figure: the one-point SWC branch that stopped 7 components from loading is repaired. The forward pass drives an all-ones synthetic 441-feature probe, not an encoded episode, and records physiology as 'unqualified'.

terms.statement: No qualified driven window at 104 cells. The 10 ms explicit run failed on Nonfinite trace: cell_7196644737/output_voltage after 2705 s; the implicit retry aborted at the wall cap after 21286 s with exit code 15 and no result.
terms.cause: Construction is not simulation. Until a driven window of physiological length completes, no population number describes anything the cells do.

terms.statement: Qualified at dt 0.000625 ms: refining to 0.0003125 ms moves the trace by 0.933 mV, inside the 1 mV contract. The four adjacent pairs give 6.36, 3.47, 1.82, 0.93 mV, halving with the step (first order).
terms.cause: This supersedes h01-ready-cell7196644737-implicit-decision.json, which compared only the two coarsest rungs and reported the gate as FAIL at 6.36 mV. The three finer rungs had already run; their traces were recovered from the 2026-09-09 worktree stash and the ladder closes as arithmetic, with no new simulation. Two limits on the reading: the gate is met by the FINEST pair on the ladder, so no rung below 0.0003125 ms confirms that convergence continues (the first-order ratios say it should, which is an extrapolation, not a measurement); and it is convergence on one isolated cell, not a claim about the other 103.

terms.statement: Measured once and it fails: H01 anatomy did not spike; no upstroke to compare. On the donor's own reconstruction the same parameters fire 4 spikes at the same input.
terms.cause: The H01 skeleton is a far larger electrical load than the Allen reconstruction the fit was made on (onset capacitance 785 pF against 125 pF; input resistance about 38 MOhm against about 98), so at 200 pA it sits on a plateau instead of spiking. Every other term in this ledger is conditional on this one, and this one has a negative reading.

note: The second product is the figure obtained by counting construction as a working simulation and setting the two unqualified terms to one. It is quoted only with its assumptions attached; it also assumes the three rejected donors score like the one donor that was scored, which the anatomy term actively contradicts.
